name: browser-use
headline: Copilot SDK - Integrate GitHub Copilot Agent
short_description: The Copilot SDK enables developers to integrate GitHub Copilot Agent into their applications. It supports multiple platforms and is ideal for automating code generation, debugging, and documentation tasks. Connects to GitHub repositories and developer tools.
author: github

sections.overview:
The Copilot SDK is an open-source toolkit for embedding GitHub Copilot Agent capabilities directly into developer applications and workflows. It supports multiple programming languages including Python, TypeScript, C#, and Rust, making it accessible to diverse development teams. The SDK enables automation of code generation, debugging, and documentation tasks through programmatic access to GitHub Copilot's intelligence. Developers can integrate Copilot functionality into custom tools, IDEs, and applications to enhance productivity and streamline development workflows. The project is actively maintained with regular updates and symbol package support across package managers like NuGet.
Automate code generation for repetitive tasks in your applications.
Integrate Copilot's agentic workflows into existing software solutions to enhance productivity.
Utilize the SDK to create custom agents that can perform specific coding tasks based on user-defined logic.
Streamline the development process by automating file edits and Git operations.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/github/copilot-sdk`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
